run_gen_gtest_pred_impl: run gen_gtest_pred_impl.py with a max arity argument to generate gtest predicate assertion header and unit test files
generate_header: generate the gtest_pred_impl.h header file with predicate assertion macros up to the given arity
generate_unittest: generate the gtest_pred_impl_unittest.cc unit test file with tests for predicate assertions up to the given arity
review_implementation_for_arity: review the ImplementationForArity function to understand how n-ary predicate assertion macros are templated and generated
review_tests_for_arity: review the TestsForArity function to understand how 64 test combinations are generated for each predicate arity
